The docstring says the last day is included, so the check should be `age_days <= REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS`. Consider also rejecting negative ages (placed_on after today): `0 <= age_days <= REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS`.

The comparison is inverted. `age_days > REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS` returns True only after the window has closed and False for every order still inside it. That contradicts the docstring, which says the last day is included, and would allow refunds on old orders while blocking recent ones. Change it to `age_days <= REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS`.
